title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Upset on the bench
hook: A player comes off the field in tears.
intro: They made an error that let in two runs.
Now they are sitting at the end of the bench.
statement: A kid who is upset needs to feel safe before they can listen.
q1: Do you sit with them for a moment right away —
q2: or give them space and check in later?
q3: Who else could sit with them?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids recover
t2: when they know their coach is not upset with them.
cta: Coaches — what do you do when a kid is upset?
ctaLines: Sit beside them. A quiet word. Space, then talk.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player comes off the field in tears.
They made an error that let in two runs. Now they are sitting at the end of the bench.
A kid who is upset needs to feel safe before they can listen.
Check in right away or give them space. Every team is different.
What do you do when a kid is upset? Share your habit in the comments.
